antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in keratinocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Frequency sweep: 447->370->306 THz descending scan, 10^-13s per step, 5 cycles targeting cytochrome_c in keratinocyte. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_III_cytochrome_bc1 activation.
